name: First Stand 2025
notes: Groups: single round robin of Bo3 series between five teams; the top four advance. Knockout: Bo5 semifinals (1st vs 4th, 2nd vs 3rd) and final.

Tiebreakers are unverified against the rulebook. Head-to-head first is reported from the rulebook by secondary sources. Head-to-head game differential and then overall game differential are consistent with the recorded outcome: KC, TES and TL tied at 1-3 with a circular head-to-head and finished 3rd, 4th and 5th. Overall game win rate is not the next criterion, because it would have ranked TL above TES.
Formats, series lengths and placements are verified by replaying the recorded results.
